### 2026-10-14 – Oct 14 -2nd work session

**1.4h**

Oct 14 -2nd work session

A few updates from this morning: while at school today, I had some realizations. First, the guide was not going to be helpful for much more than the sketch of the track. Everything else was pretty useless. So I deleted what I had and got started using what I knew, and so far it has gone well.
This is a photo of my NEW sketch, independent of the guide and using my own knowledge. Maybe it's wrong. maybe its perfect.

### 2026-10-15 – oct 15

**2h**

oct 15
Locking in.
It's already Thursday, and I am behind. So today I locked in and began doing CAD like mad. I extended the track under the first part and added a turn for the ramp. One issue I ran into was that the track was getting twisted when sweeping, so it was upside down. After a Google search, I found the twist tool in Sweep.

My track right before twisting and all my planes.
